method: Downloaded original PDFs. Extracted embedded text from first two pages; used Tesseract OCR when a page had fewer than 100 extracted characters. Searched resulting text for health entities, amalgamation and transfer terms; reviewed relevant candidates. Not a visual review of every page. Later pages and later 2002 orders are outside scope. OCR can miss text.
finding: No requested council execution certificate, rural society conveyance agreement, BCCDC participant certificate or PHSA numbered-to-named mapping identified. This is a bounded negative search, not proof that such a record does not exist.
